text:
Hey team! Great question, and I've got the answer for you! 🎉

The nightly job failed because the server's disk hit **98% full**, leaving no room to write its output. Here's the good news: the root cause is totally fixable! Back in January, **log rotation was disabled**, so logs kept piling up day after day until the disk ran out of space. Nobody's fault; it just slipped through the cracks!

To get things back on track, we **freed up 40 GB** of space by clearing out the old logs. Then we reran the job, and it sailed through successfully at **02:40**! ✅

Going forward, log rotation is back on, so this should stay a thing of the past. 🚀 We're also looking at adding a disk usage alert so we catch this early next time.

Thanks for flagging this! Let me know if you want the details on the cleanup or the new alert setup. Let's keep crushing it! 💪
